steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Coat a shallow baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.

Combine flour, parmesan, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg and milk. Dip the chicken in the egg, then dredge in the flour mixture. Place in the baking dish, and pour the melted butter evenly over the chicken.
Bake for about 1 hour and 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cheese has browned, and the chicken has cooked.

raw_recipe.headline: Baked Paprika-Parmesan Chicken
raw_recipe.description: Chicken is breaded with a Parmesan-paprika coating and baked until golden and crispy in this easy recipe. This unique combination of ingredients makes a fantastic dish that all your family will love.

video.description: A chicken dish that is crispy, savory, and cheesy. Pair with a wonderfully fresh side salad for a complete meal.

review.reviewBody: Wonderful recipe! Have made a couple of times before writing a review. The recipe is wonderful as written, but after experimenting, would suggest the following to change it up from time to time: 1)Increase the cheese to 3/4 cup using a mixture of Romano and Parmesan. 2) Used 1 tsp of a good quality paprika (makes all the difference in the flavor of the finished dish) and 1 tsp smoky paprika. 3) Added 1/2 tsp of garlic powder. 4) Decrease butter to 1/8 cup based on the increase in cheese. 5) Bake for 45 minutes tops otherwise the chicken dries out. Enjoy!

Great recipe! Per the reviews I added 1/2 cup extra parmesan cheese plus more spices to the flour/cheese mixture, 2 tsp paprika plus 1/2 tsp each of : onion powder,garlic powder, & rosemary, plus 1/2 tsp salt & dash of black pepper, and 2/3 cup melted butter instead of only 1/4 cup, came out perfect after 22 minutes in oven, my mom said it's so soft you could eat this chicken even if you didn't have teeth (she's 93 & has teeth)... haha....it's a winner!

I am covid-cooking so I used store-bought grated parmesan as there was no way I was going to make another trip to the store for the expensive stuff. I also used thighs. I brined the thighs ahead as I was going to make another recipe and ended up with this one. That was a good thing, though, as it made the chicken quite moist. I did NOT add extra salt and they were fine. These do NOT need to be baked for an hour and fifteen minutes. They would end up as dust. Start around 45-50 minutes and take their internal temperature. I had them in for about 55 minutes and they were at almost 200 degrees. I would definitely make this again. With thighs you can probably get away with a bit less butter. This is very similar to a recipe I make with bread crumbs instead of flour. Next time I might try the crumbs.

This is a fairly easy, fool proof recipe that is very tasty. BUT, take note of the other reviews - do NOT cook this for the listed time. Boneless chicken does not take that long to cook and will be dry. I set my timer for 30 minutes and then judge from there. I sprinkled a little extra parm on the top and some fresh basil leaves then the melted butter. You do not need as much butter as suggested. I added a bit of cayenne pepper to the flour mixture, personal taste.

This recipe is perfect as is, but can be easily modified to your own tastes. I like to add a bit of heat by including some hot sauce in the egg dip and chili powder or chili flakes to the dry mix. The only other change I make is to cut the chicken breasts in half lengthwise for faster and more even cooking. I served this just tonight with the “pasta w fresh tomato sauce” from this site. Will go review that as 5 stars now as well!

The Chicken Parmesan was delicious! I browned the Chicken on the stove before putting it in the oven for just 30 minutes. I didn’t add any butter to the Chicken, as the recipe called for. I will definitely make this again!

Great we even did a different way. We used zip lock bags for less clean up. While I took out my frozen tenderloins,in a Ziploc bag I had my son . Once thawed drain off access juice added salt & pepper. Wrapped parchment paper around the bag and tenderized the chicken.
We then preheat the oven to 450.
Next preped 2 separate bags one for the egg dip and the other for the flour.
 Now of course I substituted and omitted some ingredients we use wheat flour. I add more eggs , cheese, paprika, and no butter. We placed four tenderloins in the egg bag zipped it up and shake it up. Take them out ,put in flour bag repeat till you are finished with all your chicken. We placed all the chicken on pans line w/ parchment paper cooked about 20-30min til no longer pink inside.
This is quite a very simple easy to do recipe and very versatile you can make it your own and change it up make it Italian Chinese whatever you want include your children just use your imagination

This is good but needed a few tweaks! Do not cook for over an hour! Way too long for boneless chicken! I also added garlic powder and a little minced onion to mine with just a tad of olive oil in the bottom of the pan. Cooked it at 335 on my convection oven setting for 30 minutes till temp was 160. It was juicy and perfect.

Easy, tasty recipe, but there has to be an error in baking time. 75 for a BLSL chicken breast gives you chicken jerky you'd have to floss out of your teeth. I would temperature check these at 25 min, especially if you have thinner chicken breasts as pictured with the recipe. Remember, the temp will go up about 10 degrees as they rest.

This tasted SO good! Makes the house smell wonderful while it's in the oven. *You definitely need to make this.* Here are some tweaks I made to the recipe that, I think, improve an already good thing. First and foremost, I pounded the breasts out to 1/2" at the thickest so I could safely change the cooking temp and time to 425 degrees for 22-26 minutes per a similar recipe I made last week: as that one claimed, cooking the chicken at a higher temp for less time produce a moister chicken - and who doesn't have something else they'd rather be doing for the 40 minutes that chicken won't spend hanging out in the oven? Second, I used *smoked* paprika - which imparts a more *interesting* flavor. And, when I made the dredge, I substituted Panko crumbs for the flour (ooh! extra crispy!)and substituted plain Greek yogurt for the milk part of the dredge and it worked out perfectly. (Especially since we were out of milk!) All in all, even though I forgot to take a picture of my result (boo) it was a joy to behold and a wonder to eat. Thanks for this marvelous recipe, Renae!

This was delicious . I used package of chicken tenders so reduced the cooking time to 20 minutes. The coating wasn't very crisp at that time so put it under the broiler for a couple minutes. The only other difference I made was to add about an eighth tsp of cayenne which gave it a hint of heat. Served with spaghetti with a simple marinara sauce and green salad. I'll definitely make it again.

I made this dish for dinner tonight, but like most of the others who have as well, I made some adjustments to it. My Parmesan cheese has gone bad (very upset about that), so I used shredded fiesta blend (finely shredded) from Walmart, I added both garlic and onion powder, and also some slap your mama to the flour mixture (I also used whole wheat flour), I cut my 2 while breasts in half length wise so I had four thin breast “cutlets” and cooked them for 45 minutes. I paired it with chicken couscous and Italian seasoned carrots, definitely a fam favorite!!!!!

Most outstanding! THIS is what men need... EASY recipes and directions, without ingredients nobody ever heard of. Now, butterfly the breasts, stuff with poblano and shredded mozzarella, bake at 400 for an hour.

Really liked the flavoring of this chicken. Only addition I made was some garlic powder to the flour mixture. Definitely would recommend fresh grated Parmesan, which is what I used, verses the canister stuff. My chicken was done in 45-50 min and they were regular cut, not thin cut chicken. Update: reduce salt and butter. Baked at 370 for about 30 mins
Made this for supper tonight and my wife said it's a keeper! I followed the recipe except baking it for 30 minutes was plenty.

Best chicken I have ever cooked in an oven. Just phenomenal. I added the suggested garlic powder for a bit more kick and double dredged. One chicken breast just for me too 40 minutes for a perfect bake. Thank you for this recipe - I'll use this FOREVER
We hated this recipe. I keep looking at the directions to see what I did wrong and I can’t come up with anything. We won’t be making this again.
I made this for supper tonight. Really easy and delicious. I baked the breasts for 45min on a parchment lined baking sheet. Easy easy clean up. I will definitely be making this regularly.
It was so tasty! The only thing I did was add more Paprika. Loved every bite!
